configuration: ElliQ product mechanism described by the 2024 paper and official ElliQ 3/current FAQ; proprietary implementation not inspected.
sources_read: https://www.jarlife.net/4982-elliq-an-ai-driven-social-robot-to-alleviate-loneliness-progress-and-lessons-learned.html — published March 5, 2024; J Aging Res & Lifestyle 13:22–28.

S->M.label: reported
S->M.rationale: Information supplied through conversations and other interaction modalities is classified and retained in the user profile for future conversations.
S->M.locator: [ElliQ 3 announcement](https://www.intuitionrobotics.com/post/new-year-new-elliq), paragraphs describing the Relationship Orchestration Engine and user profile.
S->M.quote: is understood, classified, remembered, and then referenced in future conversations.

M->A.label: reported
M->A.rationale: Learned personality, interests, behavioral patterns and preferences from previous interactions inform autonomous initiation and personalization of suggestions.
M->A.locator: [2024 paper](https://www.jarlife.net/4982-elliq-an-ai-driven-social-robot-to-alleviate-loneliness-progress-and-lessons-learned.html), The Robot, paragraphs beginning 'ElliQ initiates social interaction' and 'ElliQ’s proactiveness'.

A->S.label: reported
A->S.rationale: A proactive check-in opens a brief response-listening window, which closes upon nonresponse. Action execution therefore controls sensing acquisition.
A->S.locator: [Current FAQ](https://elliq.com/pages/faqs), Your Privacy, 'Is ElliQ listening to me all the time?'

M->S.label: insufficient
M->S.rationale: Retained profiles guide subsequent conversations and suggestions, but no direct use of retained priors for sensing acquisition or interpretation is specified.
M->S.locator: [ElliQ 3 announcement](https://www.intuitionrobotics.com/post/new-year-new-elliq), Relationship Orchestration Engine and user-profile paragraphs; [2024 paper](https://www.jarlife.net/4982-elliq-an-ai-driven-social-robot-to-alleviate-loneliness-progress-and-lessons-learned.html), The Robot.

A->M.label: insufficient
A->M.rationale: User information and generic interaction/usage data are retained, but the sources do not specify that ElliQ's own decisions, utterances, plans or execution records enter retained memory.
A->M.locator: [Privacy policy](https://elliq.com/pages/elliq-privacy-policy), sections 4, 5(b), 9 and 11; [ElliQ 3 announcement](https://www.intuitionrobotics.com/post/new-year-new-elliq), memory description and user-facts example.

record.label: not_stated
record.rationale: Generic interaction logs do not specify retention of ElliQ's own actions; the paper's trial records are described for research and product improvement.
record.locator: [Privacy policy](https://elliq.com/pages/elliq-privacy-policy), sections 4 and 5(b); [2024 paper](https://www.jarlife.net/4982-elliq-an-ai-driven-social-robot-to-alleviate-loneliness-progress-and-lessons-learned.html), Implementation in Senior Care Settings, data-collection paragraph.

outcome.label: stated
outcome.rationale: Automatically collected response latency and timestamps are retained by the service, providing evidence of replies to interactions without establishing attribution of longer-term effects.
outcome.locator: [Privacy policy](https://elliq.com/pages/elliq-privacy-policy), section 5(b), Technical Data; sections 7, 9 and 11 establish service use, storage and retention.
outcome.quote: the User’ response time, and other related timestamps and metadata.

attribution.label: stated
attribution.rationale: Nonresponse is checked specifically after ElliQ's proactive check-in and ends that listening attempt. This establishes an immediate action-linked response check, not evaluation of long-term benefit.
attribution.locator: [Current FAQ](https://elliq.com/pages/faqs), Your Privacy, 'Is ElliQ listening to me all the time?'
attribution.quote: When ElliQ proactively checks in, she listens for a short moment for your response, and if there is no response, she stops listening.

revision.label: not_stated
revision.rationale: User-profile updates change content; algorithm calibration and training, prompting and scripting are attributed to the company or design team, not the service itself.
revision.locator: [2024 paper](https://www.jarlife.net/4982-elliq-an-ai-driven-social-robot-to-alleviate-loneliness-progress-and-lessons-learned.html), The Robot, beta-testing/calibration paragraph; [ElliQ 3 announcement](https://www.intuitionrobotics.com/post/new-year-new-elliq), user-profile and Character Design team paragraphs.
revision.what: No service-authored durable mechanism revision is identified.

later_use.label: not_stated
later_use.rationale: Later personalized conversations and software upgrades are described, but no run is identified as operating under a service-authored mechanism revision.

notes: Independent text-only review of the named configuration. Proprietary code was not inspected. Outcome and attribution are judged independently of action-record retention and mechanism revision; insufficient does not mean absent.
